Code.gs:      if (Number(item.stok_sekarang) <= Number(item.stok_minimum)) {
Code.gs:        checkAndSendEmailAlert(item);
Code.gs:        alertsCount++;
Code.gs:      }
Code.gs:    }
Code.gs:  }
Code.gs:  return `Check complete. Sent ${alertsCount} critical alerts.`;
Code.gs:}
Code.gs:
Code.gs:function checkAndSendEmailAlert(item) {
Code.gs:  if (!item || !item.kode_barang) return;
Code.gs:  const isEligible = (item.monitor_stok === 'Ya' && item.kirim_email_alert === 'Ya');
Code.gs:  if (isEligible && Number(item.stok_sekarang) <= Number(item.stok_minimum)) {
Code.gs:    const subject = `[PERINGATAN STOK] ${item.nama_barang} (${item.stok_sekarang} ${item.satuan})`;
Code.gs:    const body = `Peringatan Stok Inventory\nStatus: ${item.prioritas_alert}\nNama: ${item.nama_barang}\nStok: ${item.stok_sekarang}\nMin: ${item.stok_minimum}`;
Code.gs:    try {
Code.gs:      MailApp.sendEmail(ADMIN_EMAIL, subject, body);
Code.gs:    } catch (e) { console.error(e.message); }
Code.gs:  }
Code.gs:}

Code.gs:function handleSaveSaldoAwal(ss, payload) {
Code.gs:  const now = new Date();
Code.gs:  
Code.gs:  payload.items.forEach(item => {
Code.gs:    // 1. Update Stok di Master
Code.gs:    const masterValues = masterSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
Code.gs:    let currentSaldo = 0;
Code.gs:    
Code.gs:    for (let i = 1; i < masterValues.length; i++) {
Code.gs:        if (masterValues[i][0] == item.kode_barang) {
Code.gs:            currentSaldo = Number(masterValues[i][12] || 0);
Code.gs:            const newSaldo = currentSaldo + Number(item.qty);
Code.gs:            masterSheet.getRange(i + 1, 13).setValue(newSaldo);
Code.gs:            masterSheet.getRange(i + 1, 14).setValue(now);
Code.gs:            currentSaldo = newSaldo;
Code.gs:            break;
Code.gs:        }
Code.gs:    }
Code.gs:    
Code.gs:    // 2. Simpan Mutasi Baru sebagai SALDO AWAL
Code.gs:    mutasiSheet.appendRow([
Code.gs:      payload.tanggal || now,
Code.gs:      item.kode_barang,
Code.gs:      item.nama_barang,
Code.gs:      'SALDO AWAL',
Code.gs:      item.qty,
Code.gs:      0,
Code.gs:      currentSaldo,
Code.gs:      payload.keterangan || 'INPUT SALDO AWAL'
Code.gs:    ]);
Code.gs:  });
Code.gs:  
Code.gs:  return { success: true };
Code.gs:}

Code.gs:/**
Code.gs: * Handle Simpan Transaksi Barang Keluar
Code.gs: */
Code.gs:function handleSaveBarangKeluar(ss, payload) {
Code.gs:  
Code.gs:  const now = new Date();
Code.gs:  
Code.gs:  // 1. Simpan Header
Code.gs:  headerSheet.appendRow([
Code.gs:    payload.id_transaksi,
Code.gs:    payload.tanggal,
Code.gs:    payload.unit_id,
Code.gs:    payload.unit_nama,
Code.gs:    payload.keterangan,
Code.gs:    payload.user_input,
Code.gs:    now
Code.gs:  ]);
Code.gs:  
Code.gs:  // 2. Loop Items (Decrement Stok)
Code.gs:  payload.items.forEach(item => {
Code.gs:    // Simpan Detail
Code.gs:    detailSheet.appendRow([
Code.gs:      payload.id_transaksi,
Code.gs:      item.kode_barang,
Code.gs:      item.nama_barang,
Code.gs:      item.satuan,
Code.gs:      item.qty
Code.gs:    ]);
Code.gs:    
Code.gs:    // Update Stok di Master (KURANGI)
Code.gs:    const masterValues = masterSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
Code.gs:    let currentSaldo = 0;
Code.gs:    
Code.gs:    for (let i = 1; i < masterValues.length; i++) {
Code.gs:        if (masterValues[i][0] == item.kode_barang) {
Code.gs:            currentSaldo = Number(masterValues[i][12] || 0);
Code.gs:            const newSaldo = currentSaldo - Number(item.qty);
Code.gs:            masterSheet.getRange(i + 1, 13).setValue(newSaldo);
Code.gs:            masterSheet.getRange(i + 1, 14).setValue(now); // LAST_STOCK_UPDATE
Code.gs:            currentSaldo = newSaldo;
Code.gs:            break;
Code.gs:        }
Code.gs:    }
Code.gs:    
Code.gs:    // Simpan Mutasi Baru
Code.gs:    mutasiSheet.appendRow([
Code.gs:      now,
Code.gs:      item.kode_barang,
Code.gs:      item.nama_barang,
Code.gs:      'KELUAR',
Code.gs:      0,
Code.gs:      item.qty,
Code.gs:      currentSaldo,
Code.gs:      payload.id_transaksi
Code.gs:    ]);
Code.gs:  });
Code.gs:  
Code.gs:  return { success: true, id: payload.id_transaksi };
Code.gs:}
Code.gs:
Code.gs:function handleUpdateBarangKeluar(ss, payload) {
Code.gs:  const now = new Date();
Code.gs:
Code.gs:  // 1. REVERSAL STOK (Tambahkan kembali stok yang dulu dikurangi)
Code.gs:  const detailValues = detailSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
Code.gs:  const masterValues = masterSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
Code.gs:
Code.gs:  for (let i = detailValues.length - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
Code.gs:    if (detailValues[i][0] == payload.id_transaksi) {
Code.gs:      const kodeBarang = detailValues[i][1];
Code.gs:      const qtyLama = Number(detailValues[i][4]);
Code.gs:      
Code.gs:      for (let j = 1; j < masterValues.length; j++) {
Code.gs:        if (masterValues[j][0] == kodeBarang) {
Code.gs:          const saldoSekarang = Number(masterValues[j][12]);
Code.gs:          masterSheet.getRange(j + 1, 13).setValue(saldoSekarang + qtyLama);
Code.gs:          masterSheet.getRange(j + 1, 14).setValue(now);
Code.gs:          break;
Code.gs:        }
Code.gs:      }
Code.gs:      detailSheet.deleteRow(i + 1);
Code.gs:    }
Code.gs:  }
Code.gs:
Code.gs:  // 2. Hapus Mutasi Lama
Code.gs:  const mutasiValues = mutasiSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
Code.gs:  for (let i = mutasiValues.length - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
Code.gs:     if (mutasiValues[i][7] == payload.id_transaksi) {
Code.gs:       mutasiSheet.deleteRow(i + 1);
Code.gs:     }
Code.gs:  }
Code.gs:
Code.gs:  // 3. Update Header

Code.gs:function handleApprovePermintaan(ss, payload) {
Code.gs:  const now = new Date();
Code.gs:
Code.gs:  if (!reqHeaderSheet || !reqDetailSheet || !bkHeaderSheet || !bkDetailSheet || !masterSheet || !mutasiSheet) {
Code.gs:    return { error: 'Salah satu sheet transaksi tidak ditemukan. Jalankan Seed Database.' };
Code.gs:  }
Code.gs:
Code.gs:  // 1. Ambil Data Permintaan
Code.gs:  const rows = reqHeaderSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
Code.gs:  let reqData = null;
Code.gs:  let rowIndex = -1;
Code.gs:
Code.gs:  for (let i = 1; i < rows.length; i++) {
Code.gs:    const idInSheet = String(rows[i][0]).trim();
Code.gs:    const idInPayload = String(payload.id_permintaan).trim();
Code.gs:    const statusInSheet = String(rows[i][5]).trim().toUpperCase();
Code.gs:
Code.gs:    if (idInSheet === idInPayload && statusInSheet === 'PENDING') {
Code.gs:      reqData = rows[i];
Code.gs:      rowIndex = i + 1;
Code.gs:      break;
Code.gs:    }
Code.gs:  }
Code.gs:
Code.gs:  if (!reqData) {
Code.gs:    return { error: 'Permintaan (' + payload.id_permintaan + ') tidak ditemukan atau status bukan PENDING' };
Code.gs:  }
Code.gs:
Code.gs:  // 2. Update Details in TRX_PERMINTAAN_D first (based on final review)
Code.gs:  if (payload.item_updates) {
Code.gs:    const detailValues = reqDetailSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
Code.gs:    // Delete old
Code.gs:    for (let i = detailValues.length - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
Code.gs:      if (String(detailValues[i][0]).trim() === String(payload.id_permintaan).trim()) {
Code.gs:        reqDetailSheet.deleteRow(i + 1);
Code.gs:      }
Code.gs:    }
Code.gs:    // Re-insert final approved items
Code.gs:    payload.item_updates.forEach(item => {
Code.gs:      reqDetailSheet.appendRow([
Code.gs:        payload.id_permintaan,
Code.gs:        item.kode_barang,
Code.gs:        item.nama_barang || '',
Code.gs:        item.satuan || '', 
Code.gs:        item.qty_diminta || 0,
Code.gs:        item.qty_disetujui || 0,
Code.gs:        item.catatan_review || ''
Code.gs:      ]);
Code.gs:    });
Code.gs:  }
Code.gs:
Code.gs:  // 3. Simpan ke Barang Keluar (Distribusi)
Code.gs:  const idBK = `BK-${Date.now()}`;
Code.gs:  bkHeaderSheet.appendRow([
Code.gs:    idBK,
Code.gs:    Utilities.formatDate(now, "GMT+7", "yyyy-MM-dd"),
Code.gs:    reqData[2], // unit_id
Code.gs:    reqData[3], // unit_nama
Code.gs:    `DISTRIBUSI PERMINTAAN: ${payload.id_permintaan}`,
Code.gs:    payload.user_approver || 'Admin',
Code.gs:    now
Code.gs:  ]);
Code.gs:
Code.gs:  // 4. Proses Item & Update Stok berdasarkan Qty Disetujui
Code.gs:  const itemsToProcess = payload.item_updates || [];
Code.gs:  const masterValues = masterSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
Code.gs:  
Code.gs:  itemsToProcess.forEach(item => {
Code.gs:    const kodeBarang = item.kode_barang;
Code.gs:    const qty = Number(item.qty_disetujui);
Code.gs:    
Code.gs:    let namaBarang = item.nama_barang;
Code.gs:    let satuan = item.satuan;
Code.gs:    let currentSaldo = 0;
Code.gs:    
Code.gs:    for (let k = 1; k < masterValues.length; k++) {
Code.gs:      if (String(masterValues[k][0]).trim() === String(kodeBarang).trim()) {
Code.gs:        if (!namaBarang) namaBarang = masterValues[k][1];
Code.gs:        if (!satuan) satuan = masterValues[k][4];
Code.gs:        
Code.gs:        currentSaldo = Number(masterValues[k][12] || 0);
Code.gs:        const newSaldo = currentSaldo - qty;
Code.gs:        masterSheet.getRange(k + 1, 13).setValue(newSaldo);
Code.gs:        masterSheet.getRange(k + 1, 14).setValue(now);
Code.gs:        
Code.gs:        // Trigger Email Alert check
Code.gs:        checkAndSendEmailAlert({
Code.gs:          kode_barang: masterValues[k][0],
Code.gs:          nama_barang: masterValues[k][1],
Code.gs:          stok_minimum: masterValues[k][5],
Code.gs:          monitor_stok: masterValues[k][6],
Code.gs:          prioritas_alert: masterValues[k][7],
Code.gs:          kirim_email_alert: masterValues[k][8],
Code.gs:          satuan: masterValues[k][4],
Code.gs:          lokasi_rak: masterValues[k][10],
Code.gs:          stok_sekarang: newSaldo
Code.gs:        });
Code.gs:        
Code.gs:        currentSaldo = newSaldo;
Code.gs:        break;
Code.gs:      }
Code.gs:    }
Code.gs:
Code.gs:    bkDetailSheet.appendRow([idBK, kodeBarang, namaBarang || '', satuan || '', qty]);
Code.gs:
Code.gs:    // Mutasi
Code.gs:    mutasiSheet.appendRow([
Code.gs:      now, kodeBarang, namaBarang || '', 'KELUAR (PERMINTAAN)', 0, qty, currentSaldo, idBK
Code.gs:    ]);
Code.gs:  });
Code.gs:
Code.gs:  // 5. Update Status Permintaan
Code.gs:  reqHeaderSheet.getRange(rowIndex, 6).setValue('APPROVED');
Code.gs:  
Code.gs:  return { success: true, id_bk: idBK };
Code.gs:}

Code.gs:function handleUpdateBarangMasuk(ss, payload) {
Code.gs:  const now = new Date();
Code.gs:
Code.gs:  // 1. REVERSAL STOK (Kembalikan stok lama sebelum di-update)
Code.gs:  const detailValues = detailSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
Code.gs:  const masterValues = masterSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
Code.gs:
Code.gs:  for (let i = detailValues.length - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
Code.gs:    if (detailValues[i][0] == payload.id_transaksi) {
Code.gs:      const kodeBarang = detailValues[i][1];
Code.gs:      const qtyLama = Number(detailValues[i][4]);
Code.gs:      
Code.gs:      // Update Master (Kurangi stok yang dulu pernah ditambah)
Code.gs:      for (let j = 1; j < masterValues.length; j++) {
Code.gs:        if (masterValues[j][0] == kodeBarang) {
Code.gs:          const saldoSekarang = Number(masterValues[j][12]);
Code.gs:          masterSheet.getRange(j + 1, 13).setValue(saldoSekarang - qtyLama);
Code.gs:          masterSheet.getRange(j + 1, 14).setValue(now);
Code.gs:          break;
Code.gs:        }
Code.gs:      }
Code.gs:      // Hapus detail lama
Code.gs:      detailSheet.deleteRow(i + 1);
Code.gs:    }
Code.gs:  }
Code.gs:
Code.gs:  // 2. Hapus Mutasi Lama
Code.gs:  const mutasiValues = mutasiSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
Code.gs:  for (let i = mutasiValues.length - 1; i >= 1; i--) {

Code.gs:       mutasiSheet.deleteRow(i + 1);
Code.gs:     }
Code.gs:  }
Code.gs:
Code.gs:  // 3. Update Header
Code.gs:  const headerValues = headerSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
Code.gs:  for (let i = 1; i < headerValues.length; i++) {
Code.gs:    if (headerValues[i][0] == payload.id_transaksi) {

Code.gs:        payload.tanggal,

Code.gs:  }
Code.gs:

Code.gs:function processItems(payload, masterSheet, detailSheet, mutasiSheet, timestamp, jenis) {
Code.gs:  payload.items.forEach(item => {
Code.gs:    // Simpan Detail Baru
Code.gs:    detailSheet.appendRow([
Code.gs:      payload.id_transaksi,
Code.gs:      item.kode_barang,
Code.gs:      item.nama_barang,
Code.gs:      item.satuan,
Code.gs:      item.qty,
Code.gs:      item.harga,
Code.gs:      item.total
Code.gs:    ]);
Code.gs:    
Code.gs:    // Update Stok di Master
Code.gs:    const masterValues = masterSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
Code.gs:    let currentSaldo = 0;
Code.gs:    
Code.gs:    for (let i = 1; i < masterValues.length; i++) {
Code.gs:        if (masterValues[i][0] == item.kode_barang) {
Code.gs:            currentSaldo = Number(masterValues[i][12] || 0);
Code.gs:            const newSaldo = currentSaldo + Number(item.qty);
Code.gs:            masterSheet.getRange(i + 1, 13).setValue(newSaldo);
Code.gs:            masterSheet.getRange(i + 1, 14).setValue(timestamp);

Code.gs:

Code.gs:function handleLogin(email, password) {
Code.gs:  try {
Code.gs:    const ss = getSpreadsheet(AUTH_SPREADSHEET_ID);
Code.gs:    if (!sheet) return { success: false, error: 'Sheet users tidak ditemukan' };
Code.gs:    
Code.gs:    const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
Code.gs:    const headers = data[0];
Code.gs:    
Code.gs:    // Find column indexes
Code.gs:    let emailIdx = -1, passIdx = -1, nameIdx = -1, roleIdx = -1, statusIdx = -1;
Code.gs:    headers.forEach((h, i) => {
Code.gs:      const lower = h.toLowerCase();
Code.gs:      if (lower === 'email') emailIdx = i;
Code.gs:      if (lower === 'password') passIdx = i;
Code.gs:      if (lower === 'name') nameIdx = i;
Code.gs:      if (lower === 'role') roleIdx = i;
Code.gs:      if (lower === 'status') statusIdx = i;
Code.gs:    });
Code.gs:    
Code.gs:    if (emailIdx === -1 || passIdx === -1) {
Code.gs:       return { success: false, error: 'Kolom email atau password tidak ditemukan di sheet users' };
Code.gs:    }
Code.gs:    
Code.gs:    for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++) {
Code.gs:      if (String(data[i][emailIdx]).trim() === String(email).trim() && 
Code.gs:          String(data[i][passIdx]).trim() === String(password).trim()) {
Code.gs:        
Code.gs:        const statusStr = String(data[i][statusIdx] || '').toLowerCase();
Code.gs:        if (statusStr !== 'aktif' && statusStr !== 'true' && statusStr !== '1') {
Code.gs:          return { success: false, error: 'Akun Anda sedang tidak aktif' };
Code.gs:        }
Code.gs:        
Code.gs:        return {
Code.gs:          success: true,
Code.gs:          user: {
Code.gs:            email: data[i][emailIdx],
Code.gs:            name: data[i][nameIdx] || 'User',
Code.gs:            role: String(data[i][roleIdx] || 'UNIT').toUpperCase().replace('STAFF', 'UNIT'),
Code.gs:            token: Utilities.base64Encode(data[i][emailIdx] + ':' + Date.now())
Code.gs:          }
Code.gs:        };
Code.gs:      }
Code.gs:    }
Code.gs:    return { success: false, error: 'Email atau password salah' };
Code.gs:  } catch (e) {
Code.gs:    return { success: false, error: e.message };
Code.gs:  }
Code.gs:}

Code.gs:function getSheetData(ss, sheetName) {
Code.gs:  if (!sheet) return [];
Code.gs:  const range = sheet.getDataRange();
Code.gs:  const values = range.getValues();
Code.gs:  const headers = values[0];
Code.gs:  const data = [];
Code.gs:  
Code.gs:  for (let i = 1; i < values.length; i++) {
Code.gs:    const obj = {};
Code.gs:    headers.forEach((header, index) => {
Code.gs:      obj[header.toLowerCase()] = values[i][index];
Code.gs:    });
Code.gs:    data.push(obj);
Code.gs:  }
Code.gs:  return data;
Code.gs:}

security_spec.md:# Security Specification for SIMPERGUD RSUD
security_spec.md:
security_spec.md:## 1. Data Invariants
security_spec.md:- A transaction item (detail) cannot exist without a valid parent transaction header.
security_spec.md:- Stok updates must be accompanied by a mutation record.
security_spec.md:- Users can only access functionality based on their role (Admin, Gudang, Unit, Direktur).
security_spec.md:- Prices and quantities must be positive numbers.
security_spec.md:- Timestamps must be server-validated.
security_spec.md:
security_spec.md:## 2. The Dirty Dozen Payloads (Test Scenarios)
security_spec.md:1.  **Identity Spoofing**: Attempt to create a transaction with `user_input` as someone else's UID.
security_spec.md:2.  **Role Escalation**: A user with role 'UNIT' tries to update a transaction status to 'APPROVED'.
security_spec.md:3.  **Price Poisoning**: Attempt to save a negative price in transaction detail.
security_spec.md:4.  **Quantity Overflow**: Attempt to save an excessively large quantity (e.g., 10^12) to cause resource exhaustion.
security_spec.md:5.  **Orphan Detail**: Attempt to create a `trx_barang_masuk/{id}/items` without a header at `trx_barang_masuk/{id}`.
security_spec.md:6.  **Immutable Bypass**: Attempt to change the `created_at` or `kode_barang` of an existing mutation record.
security_spec.md:7.  **Shadow Field Injection**: Adding an `isAdmin` field to a user profile update.
security_spec.md:8.  **Empty Transaction**: Saving a header with $0 total but having items.
security_spec.md:9.  **Stok Jump**: Directly updating `stok_sekarang` in `barang` collection without a transaction.
security_spec.md:10. **PII Leak**: A 'UNIT' user tries to list all user profiles in the `users` collection.
security_spec.md:11. **Status Skipping**: Trying to set a transaction directly to 'APPROVED' without the 'PENDING' phase.
security_spec.md:12. **ID Poisoning**: Using a 1MB string as a document ID for a new item.
security_spec.md:
security_spec.md:## 3. Implementation Plan
security_spec.md:- Robust `isValid[Entity]` helpers for all collections.
security_spec.md:- `exists()` checks for relational integrity.
security_spec.md:- `affectedKeys()` for granular update permissions.
security_spec.md:- `isAdmin()` and `isRole()` helpers for ABAC.

firestore.rules:service cloud.firestore {
firestore.rules:  match /databases/{database}/documents {
firestore.rules:    // ------------------------------------------------------------
firestore.rules:    // GLOBAL HELPERS
firestore.rules:    // ------------------------------------------------------------
firestore.rules:    function isSignedIn() { return request.auth != null; }
firestore.rules:    function isVerified() { return isSignedIn() && request.auth.token.email_verified == true; }
firestore.rules:    function incoming() { return request.resource.data; }
firestore.rules:    function existing() { return resource.data; }
firestore.rules:    function isValidId(id) { return id is string && id.size() <= 128 && id.matches('^[a-zA-Z0-9_\\-]+$'); }
firestore.rules:    
firestore.rules:    function getUserData() {
firestore.rules:      return get(/databases/$(database)/documents/users/$(request.auth.uid)).data;
firestore.rules:    }
firestore.rules:    
firestore.rules:    function hasRole(role) {
firestore.rules:      return isSignedIn() && getUserData().role == role;
firestore.rules:    }
firestore.rules:    
firestore.rules:    function isAdmin() { return isSignedIn() && getUserData().role == 'ADMIN'; }
firestore.rules:    function isGudang() { return isSignedIn() && (getUserData().role == 'GUDANG' || getUserData().role == 'ADMIN'); }
firestore.rules:    function isDirektur() { return isSignedIn() && (getUserData().role == 'DIREKTUR' || getUserData().role == 'ADMIN'); }
firestore.rules:
firestore.rules:    // Deny all by default
firestore.rules:    match /{document=**} {
firestore.rules:      allow read, write: if false;
firestore.rules:    }
firestore.rules:
firestore.rules:    // ------------------------------------------------------------
firestore.rules:    // USERS COLLECTION
firestore.rules:    // ------------------------------------------------------------
firestore.rules:    match /users/{userId} {
firestore.rules:      allow get: if isSignedIn() && (request.auth.uid == userId || isAdmin());
firestore.rules:      allow list: if isAdmin();
firestore.rules:      allow create: if isSignedIn() && request.auth.uid == userId && (
firestore.rules:        incoming().keys().hasAll(['uid', 'email', 'role', 'status', 'displayName']) &&
firestore.rules:        (
firestore.rules:          incoming().role == 'UNIT' || 
firestore.rules:          (incoming().role == 'ADMIN' && incoming().email == 'aset.rsuddeliserdang@gmail.com')
firestore.rules:        )
firestore.rules:      );
